name: stock_issue_line
description: GH #3746 / REQ-715. One line of a stock issue. header_id is the record_id of the stock_issue header (not the document id); the foreign_keys entry fk_stock_issue_line_header_id promotes it to a uuid column with ON DELETE RESTRICT (inert on the soft-delete path). org_unit_id is the header's value copied by the module (queried; the scope column of decision 0076 R7). line_no is the position 1..n. quantity is an exact decimal (precision 24, scale 9, decimal_strict), always positive: the ledger leg is negative. There is no price or value on this line. catalog_item_id, catalog_uom_id and catalog_lot_id are record ids of module catalog_items (no foreign key; the module checks them at issue). Written only by module stock; after issue nothing of a line changes.
